thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — service: model-serving-us-west1 
severity: P1 (high latency) 
affected route: POST /api/generate
symptom: p50 ~ 320ms, p95 ~ 2.1s, elevated error counts in last 2m
action: page current oncall; use thread to coordinate.

jess: copying notes here — I'm taking the handoff early. Omar, you're primary for the next 3.5h (I cover if you need to escalate).

omar: on it. grabbing logs now. do we have any recent deploys in the last 15m?

kai: deploy-bot shows a canary push 12m ago for model-refactor branch, rolled out to us-west-1 only. not to global.

alex: confirmed canary. metric spike lines up with that rollout window. if it's the canary, we should failover traffic to stable or revert canary slice. runbook: /runbooks/serve-latency -> section "canary rollback".

jess: quick checklist: 1) verify KV cache hitrate (run `kubectl exec -c envoy svc-model-0 -- curl -s localhost:9911/stats | grep cache`) 2) check model GPU utilization 3) check queue lengths in inference pool 4) consider routing detour.

omar: cache hitrate low (checked). GPU usage high on node model-03 (88%). queue length for worker pool 4 -> 14. looks like hotspot on that pool.

kai: I can spin up a hotfix dedicated pool (small) but that's a manual schedule change; will take ~4-6m to provision. if we do that, we should temporarily route a portion of traffic there.

alex: escalation rules reminder from playbook: for sustained p95 > 1.5s for 10m, page SRE lead @sre-lead and inform product. For customer-affecting errors > 0.5% page eng-incident.

jess: p95 crossed 2s and still holding at 3m. Omar — please escalate to @sre-lead if p95 stays >1.5s at 10m. Meanwhile Kai, proceed with hotfix pool. If hotfix doesn't relieve within 8m, we should detour traffic to stable model variant (route alias stable-v1).

omar: escalating now — @sre-lead please join, tagging pager. Also opening a shortbridge with call link: https://zoom.company/incident-1768123456

sre-lead: on call. give me the current runbook step you're on and any mitigations already tried.

omar: actions taken: looked at cache -> low hitrate; verified canary deploy active; GPU hot on model-03; increased worker pool size by 2 as temporary; provisioning hotfix pool (kai) in parallel.

sre-lead: good. next: if routing detour to stable-v1 reduces p95 by >30% within 5m, keep it. if no improvement, we revert canary immediately. Also notify customer success if any named customers show errors >1%.

incident-bot: Update: p95 now 1.4s (after adding 2 workers). errors down to 0.2%.

jess: nice. Omar — mark in handoff note that primary changed CPU/GPU affinity on model-03 and scaled pool. leave the detour plan in place (don't execute unless we see regression).

omar: will do. I'm still primary for next 2.5h. handoff to Jess at 03:30 UTC. leaving runbook snippet here for the next oncall:```
# quick detour
curl -X POST https://route.company/api/route-set 
  -d '{"from":"/api/generate","to":"stable-v1","weight":0.3}' 
# revert
curl -X POST https://route.company/api/route-set -d '{"from":"/api/generate","to":"canary","weight":1.0}'
```

kai: hotfix pool came up; routing 20% to it now. monitoring.

incident-bot: Note: incident severity downgraded to P2 — latency improving. next automated check in 5m.

alex: for the shift note — primary: Omar (until 03:30 UTC), secondary: Jess. gap: no secondary on-call contact between 03:30-04:00 UTC (vacation overlap) — plan: if Omar needs to step off before 03:30, escalate to @sre-lead and handoff to Alex who will be standby until Jess takes over.

jess: acknowledged. I'll be at standby and will take an early swap if needed. leaving a concise summary in the post-incident doc.

omar: thanks team. closing out in 10m unless we see regression. adding action items to the ticket: scale autoscaler policy revisit, pre-provision hot pools for critical regions, improve canary throttling. :white_check_mark:
